newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: FNB MD to go over decorating contract row.
newsitem.headline: FNB MD to go over decorating contract row.

text.p: First National Bank Holdings Ltd said on Monday that managing director Barry Swart would be taking early retirement after being censured by the board for awarding bank re-decorating contracts to his daughter.
"Mr Barry Swart was earlier this year censured by the board for his insensitivity in awarding bank re-decorating contracts to a close member of his family," the bank said in a statement.

"Discussions have taken place between Mr Swart and the board of FNB and Mr Swart has indicated that, in the best interests of the bank, he wishes to take early retirement. The bank has agreed to this."
FNB said it would make a further statement about Swart's management continuity after a board meeting on Tuesday.
Swart said he would be standing down with immediate effect.
